puzzles.title: The southern allotments
puzzles.subtitle: Interlock Gardens
puzzles.story: The orchard plan leaves just the trees and the line totals. Place one tent for every tree, keep tents from touching even diagonally, and preserve a distinct tree partner for each tent.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: Shared tree candidates couple two-axis quotas and one-to-one matching. Expert/Master are provisional editorial estimates; no human solve-time or no-guess claim.

puzzles.title: The full eastern cistern
puzzles.subtitle: Interlock Gardens
puzzles.story: Nine joined cisterns share a set of row and column measurements. Set each tank waterline so that all totals agree; a wet layer fills the whole width of that tank at that height and below.
puzzles.difficultyEvidence: At least four tall tanks and four partial fills couple row and column waterline bounds. Provisional editorial tier; solver work is not a human difficulty rating.
